_notes: Classic Mount Mansfield (VT) backcountry descents. Geometry from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); run build_backcountry.py after editing.
No avalanche center forecasts Vermont, so every line here is permanently 'no avalanche forecast — conditions score only'.
Listing a line is not a recommendation to ski it.

zone.name: Mount Mansfield
zone.no_forecast_note: No avalanche center forecasts Vermont. Mansfield's steeper slides and chutes are avalanche terrain; assess it yourself.

area_hazards.Mount Mansfield: Tight, rocky tree skiing with ice bulges and thin cover early season. The upper ridge is above treeline and wind-scoured; whiteouts are common. Some lines cross land with seasonal closures.
